Claim amendment · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · 2026-10-27T13:21Z

Supersedes the `File surface` line of claim 6442789358. Everything else in it stands.

File surface: `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts` (a `label(record.FIELD)` AST macro, like `has()`), `types.ts` (a pure-data `EvalContext.optionLabels` map: field, value, label), `validate.ts` (the function catalog), `index.ts`, the catalog drift tests, `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (`applyFormulaPlan` and its callers build the map in the request locale from `ExecutionContext.locale`, and the i18n service type), one new objectql module for the label map with its test, one dogfood test that pins save response and `findOne` end to end for zh-CN and en-US, `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` and its eval json (Tier H), `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`, and one changeset. `ui/**` (`record-title.ts`, `AppContent.tsx`) is NOT touched, and `stdlib.ts` takes no resolver or translator. Stop on a breach and explain it in the report.

Why: the dev measured that no console reader evaluates a formula `nameField`. The save toast, H1, related lists and lookups all read the server's value through objectql `applyFormulaPlan`, which carries the timezone but neither the locale nor the option labels, while the console already sends `Accept-Language`. The labels are built through the one existing path, `translateObject` over the i18n bundle that `GET /meta/object` serves (picklist inheritance included), so there is no second translation path and no new keys. Search indexing is unchanged, because a formula has no column. A stored expression that calls `label()` stores the declared label, never the writer's locale.

Landed · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · 2026-10-27T15:55Z

PR #26755 merged at `76a12753` (merged 2026-10-27T15:54Z, Tier H, maintainer-approved). `76a12753` is an ancestor of `origin/main`. The PR touched 14 paths. On 13 of them, the merge tree matches the accepted head `8ffe3ae6` byte for byte. The 14th, `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, differs only by `main`'s own ADR-0142 hunks (assignment rules and the write precondition). This PR's 10 option-label lines are intact.

A formula can now render a select value as its option label in the reader's locale with `label(record.FIELD)`. For example, a zh-CN record name reads 「v2 · 清稿」, and en-US reads `v2 · Clean`. objectql builds the labels per read through `translateObject`, the path `GET /meta/object` serves. Stored expressions store the declared label. `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/objectql` minor, `Metadata-protocol: added`. The card closed through `Fixes #26608`, and this seat removes `pm:dispatched`.

Not done here: the eval is #26760. The optional publish-time refusal of `label()` on a non-options field was not taken. It faults at run time on every row.
